📖 How this report works

What it shows

Every part a vendor sells (the parts whose Vendors tab lists it): the vendor's part number, when the part was last bought from it and at what cost, and the unit that cost is for. It is the BI version of the standard Vendor Part List and reads the same data the same way. Part Vendor List is its mirror image: a part's vendors.

Last Date and Cost

They are the last cost Fishbowl keeps on the part's Vendors tab. Fishbowl updates it when a purchase order with the part is issued or saved and when its receipt is reconciled; editing or importing the vendor part changes it too. Last Date is when that happened.

  • The cost is in the vendor's currency; a cost in another currency than your home one shows its code (e.g. $37.95 USD).
  • It is per the vendor part's UOM, which may differ from the part's own (a case, a drum…).
  • Cost in home currency per part UOM (an extra column) puts every vendor on the same footing: converted at today's exchange rate and to the part's own unit. A zero cost (none recorded) is left out of it.
Using it
  • Filters → Vendor name: pick one vendor, type a pattern with % (e.g. Ac%), or leave it empty for every vendor with a part. Opened from a vendor (the Vendor module's Apps menu) the report shows that vendor and it can't be changed.
  • Click a vendor's row to show or hide its parts; Expand / Collapse do every vendor. Click a vendor or part to open it.
  • Click a column heading to sort the parts within each vendor (again to reverse, a third time for part-number order). Drag a heading onto another to move the column; drag a heading's right edge to resize it. Your layout is remembered; Settings → Reset column layout undoes it.
  • The Table / Pivot selector switches to a pivot: part × vendor with each vendor's cost in home currency per part UOM, the Total column giving each part's lowest. Change it to the lead time or a count, by any two of part, vendor, vendor part #, default vendor, UOM, currency and Last Date. Click a figure to see the vendor parts behind it. Print, PDF and Excel follow the view on screen.
  • The App / PDF buttons in the header switch between this interactive view and the printable pages, laid out like the standard report. In PDF view pick the paper size and orientation in the bar above the pages; they are remembered. Print prints those pages.
  • A very large result shows its first 10,000 or so vendor parts (whole vendors) with a Load all button.
